message.content: {"caption":"Comparison of baseline and memory-guided shopping-history navigation","description":"A two-row process diagram compares an agent without memory (top) with Reasoning Bank (bottom). Both begin at the shopping homepage and open My Account. The baseline then views the Recent Orders table and gives an incorrect first-purchase date of 3/11/23, marked with a red cross. A green memory hint says to use a link in My Orders; the Reasoning Bank path views the My Orders table and proceeds to the next page, yielding March 2, 2022, marked with a green check.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
